messages.author: 985e455b8390aae3
messages.subject: Long format to unmarkedFrameMPois, type="removal"
parts:
Dear goup...

I'm trying to use the multinomPois model for removal sampling, from
data in long format. "unmarkedFrameMPois" expects and RxJ matrix
(wide format, right?) and it's here that I see you set
type="removal". How can I turn my "long" .csv into a "wide" matrix
that unmarkedFrameMPois can accept?

Shane

messages.author: 057bfe4d4b636b43
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] Long format to unmarkedFrameMPois, type="removal"
parts:
It appears unmarked has a formatWide function, that may do it. Also,
the R package "reshape2" has the cast family of functions for turning
"tall and skinny" datasets into "short and wide" and vice-versa (cast
family and melt family respectively).

Matthew
